entries.title: 1976: Red Dye No. 4 is banned by the US Food and Drug Administration after it is discovered that it causes tumors in the bladders of dogs.
entries.summary: Scarlet GN, or C.I. Food Red 2, FD&C Red No. 4, or C.I. 14815 is a red azo dye once used as a food dye. As a food additive, it has the E number E125. It is usually used as a disodium salt.

entries.title: 2024: Anura Kumara Dissanayake is elected as the 9th President Of Sri Lanka.
entries.summary: Anura Kumara Dissanayake, commonly referred to by his initials AKD, is a Sri Lankan politician who has served as the president of Sri Lanka since 2024.

entries.title: 1993: A Transair Georgian Airlines Tu-154 is shot down by a missile in Sukhumi, Georgia.
entries.summary: From 20 to 23 September 1993, during the Sukhumi massacre, separatists in Sukhumi, Abkhazia blocked Georgian troops' overland supply routes as part of the war in Abkhazia.
